title: August 17-21, 2026
lede: Read this first — the shape of the week changed Friday afternoon. Reddit joins the S&P 500 before Tuesday's open, which is forced index buying on a known date, not a news event. The retail earnings gauntlet then runs Tuesday through Friday and gives a clean consumer read four sessions running. The only macro gate is FOMC minutes Wednesday at 1:00pm. The heavy block is the week AFTER this one — NVDA earnings Wed 8/26, then Jackson Hole Aug 27-29 — so this week stays unusually clean for single-name catalyst trades.

heroes.title: RDDT — S&P 500 Inclusion
heroes.why: S&P Dow Jones Indices announced Friday 8/14 that Reddit replaces AvalonBay (AVB) in the index, effective prior to Tuesday's open. Index funds have to buy — mechanical demand on a fixed date, which is the cleanest catalyst on the board. Friday's prep already had RDDT 2U on the day, week and quarter, and inside on the month and year.

heroes.title: Retail Gauntlet
heroes.why: HD Tuesday, then TGT + LOW + TJX all Wednesday morning, WMT Thursday, BJ Friday. Four consecutive sessions of consumer data straight from the companies — landing right after a hot PPI. The read-throughs matter more than any single print: HD sets the tone Tuesday and LOW trades off it Wednesday.

heroes.title: FOMC Minutes
heroes.why: Minutes from the July 28-29 meeting, on the standard three-week release schedule. This is the single macro event that can override single-name catalysts this week, and it lands mid-afternoon — after the Wednesday retail prints have already traded. Nothing else on the calendar competes with it.

watch.body: S&P 500 inclusion, effective before the open. Replaces AvalonBay (AVB). Announced Friday 8/14 by S&P Dow Jones Indices. Added to the standing calendar this week. VERIFIED
NVIDIA Q2 FY27 earnings. Results ~3:20pm CT, conference call 4:00pm CT. Biggest single catalyst of the month, and it lands the day before Jackson Hole opens. VERIFIED

Likely iPhone event invitation. Not the event — the announcement of it. Apple confirmed a first-half-of-September event to retail staff; on its four-year pattern the invite goes out two weeks prior. Event itself likely Sept 8–9. UNCONFIRMED

Jackson Hole symposium. Re-verified against the KC Fed this week: Aug 27-29, not this week. Theme is Financial Innovation — Implications for Payments and Policy. The Chair is not yet on the published agenda; the KC Fed posts it shortly before. VERIFIED

No investor days, analyst days, or conferences on file for 8/17–8/21 beyond RDDT. That is still a gap in the calendar rather than proof of a quiet week — 45 of the 53 tickers on the list have not been swept yet.

howto: The one mechanical catalyst is Tuesday's open.

RDDT index inclusion is forced buying on a fixed date — funds tracking the S&P have to own it, and they have to own it by Tuesday. That is a different animal from an earnings reaction, where direction is unknown until the print. The risk is that it front-ran into Friday's announcement pop, so the setup is about how it handles the actual inclusion, not the news.
Front half is where the clean single-name setups are.

Monday is thin. Tuesday and Wednesday give HD, then TGT/LOW/TJX/ADI, with no competing macro until Wednesday at 1:00pm. That is the window where a catalyst trade can breathe. Monday and Wednesday are also 0DTE days.
Read-throughs to have mapped before Tuesday opens.

HD → LOW is the obvious one, same-day-plus-one. TGT → WMT is the other. ADI reads across the analog complex. BABA drags BIDU, IQ, ZTO and NTES with it. Mapping these Sunday is worth more than reacting to them Wednesday.
Back half is macro-gated, and the real block is next week.

FOMC minutes Wednesday is the only gate inside this week. The heavy sequence is NVDA earnings Wed 8/26 (results 3:20pm CT, call 4:00pm CT) followed immediately by Jackson Hole Aug 27-29. Consistent with the paid-before-events rule, anything working into the 26th is a candidate to close rather than carry through.
